title: Weekly Dose of Optimism #215
gist: Packy McCormick's weekly optimism roundup: Goodfire's Nick Cammarata claims neural networks are 'already clean' (good for interpretability), Arrowhead's ARO-MAPT cut CSF tau 73%, robotics foundation models advance, and Applied Materials opens a $5B pre-competitive chip R&D centre.

insights.claim: Goodfire's Nick Cammarata argues the polysemanticity and superposition evidence was misread as arbitrary packing when it was mostly 'recursive generalization', so network mechanisms are legible and interpretability may be solved by the time it is most needed.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: If correct, alignment tractability improves and AI-safety risk premia fall; early-stage claim to monitor for replication.

insights.claim: Cammarata says the vast majority of neurons in models up to trillions of parameters are legible and calls it a bitter lesson for interpretability: the simple thing at absurd scale works, with automated scientists accelerating progress.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Automated interpretability research could scale quickly.
insights.quote: the simple thing, at absurd scale, works.

insights.claim: Physical Intelligence opened its Pi API beta, letting companies upload robot data, fine-tune a pi model on Pi's compute and run inference on their own robots, with early use in strawberry picking, server assembly and autonomous wheel loaders.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Robotics-as-an-API lowers deployment friction for physical AI.
insights.locator: (4) Another Very Big Week for Robotics

insights.claim: Nature Will's Natura-1 is a 50-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model pretrained on one million hours of egocentric human video, then post-trained on a small amount of robot data, avoiding costly robot-data collection.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Human-video pretraining is the emerging path to cheap robot data; a signal of Chinese competitiveness.
insights.locator: (4) Another Very Big Week for Robotics

insights.claim: Google DeepMind's Gemini Argon taught an Apollo humanoid to play cornhole from a video, building its own simulation, running system identification and training the throw without a task-specific controller.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Demonstrates generalist sim-to-real learning from video.
insights.locator: (4) Another Very Big Week for Robotics

insights.claim: Flexport opened a new automated fulfillment center near Chicago where robots move real freight for real customers, though demos historically convert poorly into valuable robots.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Warehouse automation is a near-term commercial robotics channel.
insights.locator: (4) Another Very Big Week for Robotics

insights.claim: Applied Materials opened the $5B, 600,000-square-foot EPIC Center in Sunnyvale with TSMC, Intel, Samsung, SK hynix and Micron as founding partners, to run materials, equipment and pilot-production stages in parallel and work on process technology three to four generations ahead of production.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Compressing the roughly decade-long chip development cycle benefits equipment makers and the AI hardware stack.
insights.locator: (5) Applied Materials Unveils $5B Chip R&D Center

insights.claim: Packy frames EPIC as Moore's Law as a self-fulfilling prophecy in which participants invest ahead of future bottlenecks because they believe the curve will continue.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Collective pre-competitive investment sustains the exponential in semis.
insights.locator: (5) Applied Materials Unveils $5B Chip R&D Center

insights.claim: Arrowhead's ARO-MAPT interim Phase 1/2a data showed mean cerebrospinal-fluid total tau down 73% at Day 105 after two subcutaneous 12.8 mg/kg doses in healthy volunteers, with one participant at 85%, suggesting possible quarterly or less frequent dosing.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: First credible RNAi delivery across the blood-brain barrier; efficacy data in early Alzheimer's cohorts due in 2027.
insights.locator: (3) Arrowhead Shot Cuts Tau in the Brain by 73%

insights.claim: Bristol Myers Squibb and RayzeBio's RYZ101 significantly delayed progression of neuroendocrine tumors in a 343-patient trial.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick

insights.claim: Tesla unveiled the second-generation Roadster at a SpaceX test site, claiming a 0-60 in about a second with cold-gas nozzles enabling hovering manoeuvres, with Musk saying production starts in 2028.
insights.speaker: Packy McCormick
insights.so_what: Marketing spectacle with a long-dated production claim; discount accordingly.
